def approve(expense_id, actor_id, db):
    with db.transaction():
        db.execute('UPDATE expenses SET approved = 1 WHERE id = ?', (expense_id,))
        db.execute('INSERT INTO approval_audit (expense_id, actor_id) VALUES (?, ?)', (expense_id, actor_id))
